local_claw_preliminary_review.resource_shape_rationale: STANDARD: 2 REQUIRED routes (mechanism core + observability) carry the shape; 2 conditional reserves reflect population-comparison and counterexample uncertainty. S1's SRP has the widest single evidence landscape (mechanism), hence the largest single allocation.
local_claw_preliminary_review.possible_underallocation: mechanism core (10 min) may be tight for a genuinely large cell-resolution evidence landscape; noted as a risk, not a claim of inaccuracy.
